purpose: Permit immediate transition from the prospectively frozen L15 clean-surface convergence-extension adjudication to the already frozen CO adsorption-site ordering screen without rerunning the clean-surface matrix or changing scientific settings.
scientific_scope: provenance and schema handoff only; no scientific setting, threshold, model, pseudopotential, convergence rule, geometry rule, candidate-selection rule, or kinetic input is changed

authoritative_current_audit.workflow: CO Cu111 L15 post-relax adjudication v1

compatibility_bridge.purpose: Present the authoritative extension-gate PASS to the unchanged site-ordering runner using its pre-existing clean-gate input schema, without re-adjudicating or altering any value used to select the clean surface.

handoff_rules: Do not start adsorption-site calculations unless the authoritative L15 extension gate is CLEAN_SURFACE_PASS and next_gate is PBE_CO_SITE_ORDERING_SCREEN.
Require a non-null selected candidate and retrieve that exact case_id from the immutable original clean-surface candidate run.
Require exactly one source summary matching the selected case_id and require that source row to be COMPLETE and role=candidate.

The compatibility bridge may only copy authoritative extension-gate fields into the legacy clean-gate schema required by the unchanged site-ordering runner; it may not recompute, average, reinterpret, tune, or reselect anything.
Do not rerun the completed clean-surface Cartesian matrix merely to reach site ordering.
Use the exact frozen Stage A Quantum ESPRESSO engine and pseudopotential bundle already bound by the site-ordering protocol.
Run only the four prospectively frozen sites top, bridge, fcc_hollow, and hcp_hollow with the unchanged primary and independent-audit rules.
If the L15 extension gate is not CLEAN_SURFACE_PASS, stop with no site-ordering computation and preserve the scientific HOLD exactly.
Kinetic, diffusion, experimental site-ordering, chi, or expected ChemSA outcomes remain forbidden as selectors or tuners.
